responsibility: This header defines the shared data model and interfaces for the gengtype toolchain. It declares the core representations for input files, file locations, GTY types, fields, options, typedefs, variables, output files, language bitmaps, token kinds, and debugging helpers, along with the cross-file APIs for parsing, type construction, state serialization, and code emission that are used jointly by gengtype.cc, gengtype-parse.cc, and gengtype-state.cc.
same_name_distinction: Interface header for the gengtype generator: it centralizes the shared data structures, enums, globals, and APIs used across gengtype.cc, gengtype-parse.cc, and gengtype-state.cc. Unlike gcc/gengtype.cc, it does not drive the tool or generate output itself; it defines the common representation and declarations that the implementation files use.
